name: Alfie Lawless
bio: Alfie is an experienced young actor from Northern Ireland. This year has seen Alfie take on the role of Frank in the BFI Network short film STANLEY, written and directed by Zak Razvi. Alfie can currently be seen starring as Henry Thompson alongside Seamus O'Hara in the powerful second season of BLUE LIGHTS (BBC).
place: Donaghadee, County Down, Northern Ireland, UK

credits.title: Weeks
credits.overview: A daughter grapples to understand her dying mother through fables from her childhood. From present London to 1950s Ireland, a surreal, unsentimental look at the Hinterland between life and death, the bias of memory, and the thirst for narrative in the face of mortality.

credits.title: The Death of Robin Hood
credits.overview: Grappling with his past after a life of crime and murder, Robin Hood finds himself gravely injured after a battle he thought would be his last. In the hands of a mysterious woman, he is offered a chance at salvation.

credits.title: Stanley
credits.overview: Spending time with his grandson allows a pensioner come to terms with the death of his partner.
